## Acceptance

- [ ] Human review is hash-bound before confirmation runs; AI-only work stays exploratory.
- [ ] All cells/controls and recomputable metrics are present; H1 claims match evidence.
- [ ] English/Chinese numbers, limits and status agree.
- [ ] Media sources, captions, full local videos and PDF page checks are recorded.
- [ ] Other windows are untouched.
- [ ] Owner explicitly approved this reviewed revision for merge.

Later changes need re-review. Keep incomplete PRs as drafts; no auto-merge or direct main push.
